grpo_897_baseline.note: checkpoint-90 performs well on original 897 test set but catastrophically collapses on 10k

critical_findings.prompt_fix_result: Adding 'Analysis Process' section to system prompt made almost NO difference (33.23% -> 33.28% accuracy)
critical_findings.collapse_description: GRPO checkpoint-90 shows severe class collapse on 10k data (99.7% predictions as Neutral) but performs well on original 897 test set (82.72% accuracy)
critical_findings.root_cause_hypothesis: GRPO model learned distribution-specific patterns from training data. The 10k dataset, despite being from same categories, has different review text patterns or sampling characteristics that trigger collapse behavior.
critical_findings.sft_robustness: SFT model maintains consistent performance across both datasets (77.67% on 10k vs similar on 897), demonstrating better generalization

checkpoint_evolution.observation: Performance improves slightly on 897 set through training, but collapses catastrophically on 10k set

thesis_implications.conclusion: GRPO training for this model resulted in distribution-specific learning that fails to generalize to larger-scale data from same categories. The model learned to exploit reward function in ways specific to training data characteristics.
thesis_implications.key_lesson: SFT demonstrates superior generalization robustness. GRPO requires careful reward function design to prevent class collapse on out-of-distribution samples.
thesis_implications.recommendation: For thesis: Use SFT model as primary approach. GRPO experiments should document this failure mode as a limitation and discuss reward function design considerations.
